description: Fork of exp475 (LION, 1.4962). SINGLE change: TinyOrderedMultiHeadLut(CONNECTED_QUADRUPLES, NAP=6) for all 4 modules. 1 quadruple/table -> max_orders=24 (4!=24 reachable of 64).
